title: Inside the suit
summary: The club mascot is a seven-foot badger, and the lad inside it this season is the groundsman's grandson. He's sixteen, he's boiling, and he's been told he's getting sacked. A season on, the badger is still there.

ends.title: The badger
ends.text: You saved the groundsman's grandson's job as the badger. He does a backflip in it now.

ends.title: A new badger
ends.text: The groundsman's grandson lost his job as the badger. The new one stands where he's told.

event.title: The badger
event.speaker: groundsman
setup: Before kick-off, behind the dugout. The club badger has its head off and the lad inside is crying. {groundsman.short} has his arm round him. Last week the badger fell into the away fans' end.

say: "The chairman says he's finished after today. Sixteen. He loves it, the daft lad. If a player said something, though."

replies.label: "I'll have a word with the chairman."
Get a photo with the badger in front of everyone.

word.text: You find {chairman.short} in the lounge at half time. He says he'll think about it, which from him means yes.

photo.text: You do a photo with the badger in the centre circle. The club's post gets ten times the usual likes. The chairman keeps the badger.

nothing.text: He puts the head back on and walks out for one last game. He waves at everyone.

beats.title: Still the badger

event.title: Still the badger
event.speaker: groundsman
setup: A season on. The badger is in the tunnel before kick-off.
{if arc.path=='saved'}It does a backflip when it sees you. It's taken him all summer.{/if}
{if arc.path=='sacked'}It's a different lad in it. He walks like he's been told to.{/if}

outcomes.text: He high fives you so hard the head comes off. {groundsman.short} puts it back on him.
The new badger high fives you without much in it.
He does another backflip at your back.
The new badger stands where he's been told to.

beats.hint: A season on, the club mascot
